summary: Tested Phase 4c/4d admin-web + iOS changes via build, API regression tests, UI smoke, and Swift static review. Found a critical middleware/API integration bug blocking iOS meal-plan calls.

critical.issue: Unauthenticated request returns 307 redirect to /login (middleware) instead of route-level 401 missing_authorization required by Phase 4c.

integration_issues.issue: Edge middleware blocks API path before Supabase JWT validation runs, so mobile clients are redirected to /login.

action_items: Update admin-web middleware PUBLIC_PATHS/matcher to allow /api/ai/meal-plan through without admin session redirect.
Re-run unauthorized meal-plan test to confirm 401 missing_authorization contract.
Provide valid admin test credentials and ADMIN_PASSWORD in test env to enable authenticated Settings UI validation.
critical_code_review_comments: src/middleware.ts currently allows only /login, /api/login, /api/logout as public. This conflicts with mobile API usage for /api/ai/meal-plan.
In route.ts, config checks (Supabase/OpenAI) run before missing Authorization check; when env is absent local behavior becomes 503, masking auth contract during local smoke tests.
Swift side wiring (RootView, MainTabView, AuthService, AIService, AppState) is structurally consistent with requested Phase 4c/4d flows.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin-web dev server was started locally on :3000 for this run. pytest captured 1 fail/2 pass. Re-validate /api/ai/meal-plan after middleware change and then test Settings mobile-config panel interactions with real admin login.
rca of the issue: Repro: POST /api/ai/meal-plan without cookies/tokens returns 307 redirect to /login. Cause: middleware.ts applies admin session gate to nearly all paths, including mobile API endpoints, and does not exempt /api/ai/meal-plan. Mitigation: add API allowlist or matcher exclusions for mobile-consumed endpoints so route-level Supabase JWT checks can execute and return 401/403 appropriately.
mocked_integrations: MOCKED: Google Sign-In native iOS flow is scaffolding-only. MOCKED: StoreKit purchase and ABA receipt upload remain stub/mock flows.
